description: Complete redesign of the Settings page (src/pages/Settings.tsx) with General settings view including left nav, center content with forms/toggles, and right sidebar with account/system info
steps: Replace the entire contents of /projects/sandbox/NVLabsCompany/dashboard/src/pages/Settings.tsx with the new implementation
Page header: Settings/gear icon + 'Settings' title + subtitle 'Manage your preferences, system configuration, and platform settings'

Left navigation sidebar (~20% width): vertical menu with 15 items (General active with blue/indigo highlight, Profile, Security, API Keys, Integrations, Teams & Users, Roles & Permissions, Billing & Subscription, System Configuration, Notifications, Data & Storage, Backup & Restore, Audit Logs, Appearance, Advanced)

Center content (~50% width) - Section 1 'Platform Information': text inputs for Platform Name ('NVLABS Mission Control'), Tagline ('AI-Powered Security Operations Platform'), Time Zone dropdown ('(GMT+05:30) Asia/Kolkata'), Date Format dropdown ('May 16, 2024 (MMM DD, YYYY)') with 'Save Changes' blue button
Center content - Section 2 'Language & Region': Language dropdown ('English (US)'), Number Format dropdown ('1,234.56') with 'Save Changes' blue button

Center content - Section 3 'Default Preferences': 2x2 grid of toggle switches - Auto refresh dashboard (ON), Shortcut tips (ON), Compact mode (OFF), Confirm before delete (ON), each with description text, 'Save Changes' blue button

Center content - Section 4 'Session Settings': Session Timeout dropdown ('30 minutes') with description, Concurrent Sessions toggle (ON), Max Session Duration dropdown ('8 hours') with description, 'Save Changes' blue button
Right sidebar (~25% width) - Account Overview: avatar + 'Navi Yanka' + email 'navi.yanka@nvlabs.dev' + 'Edit Profile' outlined button

Right sidebar - Subscription Plan: 'Enterprise' purple badge, description, Active status (green), Renewal Date June 16 2024, Seats 12/25, Storage 256 GB / 1 TB, 'Manage Subscription' button with external link icon
Right sidebar - System Information: Version v2.1.0, Environment Production, Uptime 15d 6h 24m, Last Updated May 16 2024 10:25 AM, 'View System Health' button with external link icon
Right sidebar - Danger Zone: red header, warning text, 'Clear Cache' button with description and chevron, 'Delete Account' button with red text, description, and chevron
Footer: '© 2024 NVLABS Mission Control. All rights reserved.' with links: Documentation, Support, Privacy Policy, Terms of Service (all with external link icons)

Styling: dark theme (dark-bg, dark-surface, dark-card tokens), form inputs with bg-dark-bg and border-white/[0.08], toggles styled with Tailwind (blue ON, gray OFF), text-white primary, text-gray-400 secondary
Use Card component from @/components/common/Card for card sections, lucide-react for all icons
All data must be static/hardcoded mock data, no API calls, no randomness
Verify TypeScript compilation passes with zero errors
acceptance_criteria: Running 'npx tsc --noEmit' in the dashboard directory produces zero errors
Running 'npm run build' in the dashboard directory succeeds
The Settings.tsx file contains the complete redesigned page with all 4 center sections, left nav, right sidebar, and footer
All form fields contain the exact default values specified in the requirements
Toggle switches show correct ON/OFF states as specified
All specified icons from lucide-react are used correctly
